INSERT INTO threads_posts (post_id, post_url, profile_url, username, text, created_at, like_count, reply_count, repost_count, has_video, video_url, thumbnail_url, niche, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.post_id }}',
  {{ $json.post_url ? "'" + $json.post_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.profile_url ? "'" + $json.profile_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ ($json.username || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  {{ $json.like_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.reply_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.repost_count || 0 }},
  true,
  {{ $json.video_url ? "'" + $json.video_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.thumbnail_url ? "'" + $json.thumbnail_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ ($json.niche || 'general').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  'scraped'
)
ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET
  like_count = EXCLUDED.like_count,
  reply_count = EXCLUDED.reply_count,
  video_url = EXCLUDED.video_url,
  thumbnail_url = EXCLUDED.thumbnail_url,
  text = EXCLUDED.text,
  niche = EXCLUDED.niche;
